Headquarters: Remote, US, Washington DC

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team

Celonis Services is the delivery engine of our Celonis Customer Organization, responsible for turning the Celonis platform into measurable, business-critical outcomes for our customers. In the AI era, our role has elevated: as AI agents like our own Apollo take on more of the technical build, our people focus on the work that drives real impact—understanding our customers' business-critical problems, designing the solutions that solve them, and quantifying the value delivered. Our Deployment Engineers and Deployment Architects pair deep domain and industry expertise with serious platform mastery and AI-augmented delivery, directing agentic systems while owning the judgment, architecture, and customer relationships that AI cannot replace. We deliver faster and smarter than ever, and we own the outcome: solution go-live, solution adoption, initial value realization support and the long-term success of our customers.

The Role

As a Deployment Engineer, you are the backbone of Celonis delivery. You lead the hands-on implementation of Celonis solutions for enterprise customers, combining platform expertise with AI-augmented workflows to deliver high-quality outcomes, fast. You use Celonis’s AI deployment tools as your primary instruments - directing agents to build data models, generate analyses, and configure operational solutions, while applying your own judgment to validate outputs, adapt to customer context, and ensure business relevance.

This is not a traditional consulting role where you build everything manually. You are an AI-augmented delivery professional: you specify what needs to be built, direct AI agents to execute wherever possible, validate the results, and iterate with the customer. You generate value by understanding the customer’s business, translating their needs into technical specifications and solutions, and ensuring the platform delivers measurable impact.

The Work You’ll Do

Initiate and Connect

• Conduct business discovery workshops to translate customers’ strategic objectives into high-impact Celonis use cases

• Collaborate with the customer’s IT and business stakeholders to define project scope, data requirements, and success criteria

• Ensure data connectivity and extraction pipelines are properly configured, working with specialist resources if required

Build & Value

• Direct AI deployment agents (Apollo) to build data models, process analyses, KPIs, and dashboards - writing clear specifications and validating agent outputs against business requirements

• Build and configure Celonis solutions across the platform: Process Intelligence Graph, data transformations, process analysis, operational solutions, and AI-powered insights

• Identify process inefficiencies and root causes using Celonis technology, always in close collaboration with the customer

• Validate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, business relevance, and alignment with customer context - applying domain knowledge where the AI cannot

• Lead value creation workshops and define measures to improve process inefficiencies

• Define and build KPIs measuring the customer’s success and quantify business impact

• Design and build operational solutions to drive value, adoption and improve process conformance

 Rollout, Adoption, and Handover

• Enable key customer users to use and extend the solution independently, setting the foundation for long-term adoption

• Manage project outcomes against timelines, scope, and customer expectations

• Train and demonstrate to customer users, guiding them on the path to sustained value

• Document solution design decisions and configurations for future reference and handoff

Domain & Industry Depth

• Develop and maintain deep expertise in one or more process domains or industry verticals.

• Translate domain knowledge into scalable solution patterns, reference architectures, and best practices that the broader team can leverage

• Proactively identify and standardize high-value use cases within your domain, collaborating with Product and Business Apps teams to shape the platform roadmap

What Makes This Role Different in the AI Era

• You work with AI agents as your primary tools - your job is to direct, validate, and refine their output, not to write every line of code or build every analysis manually

• You need strong specification and context engineering skills - the ability to translate a customer’s ambiguous business need into a precise instruction that an AI agent can execute correctly

• You are expected to continuously learn and adapt as AI capabilities evolve, experimenting with new approaches and sharing what works with your peers

• You balance speed with quality - AI accelerates execution, but you own the judgment calls on whether the output is right for this customer

• You think in sustainable software solutions. While AI agents will generate first results quickly, you need to ensure that the operational solutions you build in Celonis are robust, user friendly, maintainable, and scalable

The Qualifications You Need

• Experience: 6+ years with demonstrated project leadership in Management or IT consulting, data/solution consulting, or process improvement consulting within software vendors, consulting firms, or system integrators. 

• Platform skills: Advanced in SQL, additional experience in Python is highly preferred. Ability to build and configure solutions on the Celonis platform, including data modeling, process analysis, KPI definition, and automation. 

• AI fluency: Comfort working with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.). Ability to write clear specifications, evaluate AI-generated outputs, and iterate effectively. Experience with prompt engineering or context engineering is a strong plus.

• Business and process domain expertise : Strong understanding /deep expertise working in the Public Sector Industry. Knowledge of standard ERPs (SAP, Oracle) and process areas (Inventory Management, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, Accounts Payable) is a strong plus.

• Consulting skills: Ability to steer customer workshops, present findings to management, manage stakeholder expectations, and deliver outcomes in the face of adversity and ambiguity. Comfortable working with both technical and business audiences. 

• Analytical mindset: Excellent problem-solving skills with a value-driven orientation. Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions and quantify business impact.

• Learning agility: Willingness to continuously develop expertise through experimentation. Comfort with ambiguity and evolving tools.

• Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s in Technology Management, Business Informatics, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a comparable field.

• Languages: Fluency in English required. Additional languages are a plus.

• Travel: Willingness to travel to customer location up to 50%, according to customer requirement and project delivery phases. 

Visa Sponsorship is not offered for this role

This role is an excellent opportunity to develop consulting skills, gain exposure to senior client stakeholders, and build expertise in transformation & change methodologies and the Atlassian ecosystem.

Data Science, Analytics, and Digital Transformation** * Identify opportunities to apply data science, advanced analytics, AI/ML, and GenAI to biopharmaceutical development and manufacturing. * Understand use cases involving process data analysis, manufacturing analytics, process monitoring, predictive maintenance, quality analytics, and process optimization. * Collaborate with data science and engineering teams to translate domain problems into analytical use cases and technical requirements. * Support the development of use cases involving process data integration, laboratory data, manufacturing data, quality data, and operational reporting. * Evaluate how digital solutions can support data-driven decision-making, process understanding, operational efficiency, and quality improvement. * Help ensure proposed solutions reflect relevant biopharma workflows, data requirements, and regulatory considerations. **5. Proposal and Solution Development Support** * Contribute to technical proposals, solution presentations, statements of work, RFP/RFI responses, and other pre-sales documentation. * Translate client requirements into functional requirements, business use cases, and solution specifications. * Collaborate with technology, data engineering, AI/ML, and delivery teams to assess solution feasibility and scope, especially for CPV-Auto and its related products * Provide domain inputs for solution architecture discussions, implementation approaches, project estimates, and delivery planning. * Develop reusable industry-specific presentations, case studies, use cases, and sales enablement materials. **6. Client Engagement and Stakeholder Management** * Build credibility with stakeholders across process development, manufacturing, MSAT, QA/QC, laboratory operations, data science, and digital transformation. * Facilitate discussions between business stakeholders and technical teams to establish a shared understanding of requirements. * Explain the business impact, operational benefits, and potential limitations of proposed solutions. * Gather customer feedback and identify emerging business needs, industry trends, and opportunities for service expansion. * Support client relationship development and contribute to long-term business growth. **7. Cross-Functional Collaboration** * Work closely with sales, pre-sales, engineering, data science, AI/ML, and delivery teams. * Provide domain guidance during solution design, proof-of-concept development, and customer presentations. * Validate the relevance of proposed use cases against actual biopharma processes and customer requirements. * Stay informed about developments in biopharmaceutical manufacturing, quality systems, digital transformation, and data-driven operations. **Required Skills & Qualifications** * 5+ years of experience in the biopharmaceutical, biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or life sciences industry, with relevant experience in process development, manufacturing, QA/QC, MSAT, or related functions. * Strong subject matter expertise in one or more of the following areas, with working knowledge of the broader biopharma value chain: * Process Development: Upstream and downstream processing, process characterization, scale-up, process optimization, and technology transfer. * Large Molecules: Biologics, monoclonal antibodies (mAbs), recombinant proteins, and other relevant large-molecule modalities. * Manufacturing: Biopharmaceutical manufacturing operations, GMP practices, batch processes, production workflows, and manufacturing performance. * Quality Assurance (QA) / Quality Control (QC): Quality management systems, deviations, CAPA, change control, validation, analytical testing, and compliance documentation. * MSAT: Manufacturing process support, technology transfer, process validation, troubleshooting, process monitoring, and continued process verification. * Data Science and Analytics: Understanding of data analysis, statistical methods, process data, manufacturing analytics, and AI/ML applications in life sciences. * Ability to connect biopharma business and operational challenges with technology-enabled solutions. * Experience in customer-facing roles, pre-sales, solution consulting, technical consulting, business development support, or industry-focused presentations. * Strong communication, presentation, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills. * Ability to explain complex scientific, manufacturing, quality, and data-related concepts to technical and non-technical audiences. * Experience collaborating with multidisciplinary teams across scientific, operational, commercial, and technology functions. **Company Overview:** Aventior is a leading provider of innovative, end-to-end technology solutions, empowering businesses across diverse industries to solve complex challenges and accelerate growth. We harness the power of cutting-edge technologies such as artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), MLOps, and DevOps to build scalable, future-ready solutions that drive measurable business outcomes for the biopharma and the life sciences industry. Our expertise extends across the entire data lifecycle. These capabilities enable organizations to unlock the full value of their data and make faster, more informed decisions. **About CPV-AUTO platform** The CPV-AUTO platform is designed to support diverse teams across the manufacturing industry through an integrated suite of modules that streamline data transcription, investigation, statistical analysis, and reporting-all within a single platform. The platform converts data from scanned PDFs into structured, analysis-ready formats that can be seamlessly used for downstream analytics or pushed into customer databases. To support this process, the CAM module provides customers with a centralized portal to review audit trails for investigations, search parameters across multiple batches, and identify deviations efficiently. Beyond data transcription, the platform enables statistical analysis of process performance, comprehensive reporting, and executive-level dashboards, providing valuable insights into performance metrics across batches and products. These capabilities help teams make informed, data-driven decisions with greater visibility into their operations.

2c34e3d614abab67.description:
About CIBC:
CIBC is a leading North American bank, with a history of more than 150 years of living our purpose - to help make your ambition a reality. Client relationships are at the center of our strategy, and our growth is enabled by a highly engaged and connected global team. From digital banking to community impact, we’re proud to drive progress for our clients and our communities. Recognized for our culture, award-winning innovation and community investment, CIBC continues to evolve by putting people and progress at the centre of everything we do.

About CIBC India:
CIBC India is a technology and operations hub in Hyderabad, where you’ll be part of our highly engaged and global team, and play a central role in supporting our growth. Whether you’re driving innovation in digital banking or streamlining client onboarding, you’ll be part of a culture recognized for excellence and investment in people. At CIBC India, people and progress are at the center of what we do: you’ll develop skills, collaborate with industry leaders, and see your ideas realized in a culture that values progress and belonging. We provide cutting-edge resources, ongoing learning, and a supportive environment where people come first. If you’re ready to create meaningful change and build your future, CIBC India is where your ambition meets opportunity.

What CIBC India Offers:
At CIBC India, your goals are a priority. We start with your strengths and ambitions and strive to create opportunities to tap into your potential. We aspire to give you a career that goes well beyond your compensation.
We work to recognize you in meaningful, personalized ways including competitive fixed pay, performance-based incentive programs, a family-first benefits program, employer contributions for your retirement, attractive time off and leave offerings, wellbeing support, and MomentMakers, our social, points-based recognition program.
Our spaces and technological toolkit will make it simple to bring together great minds to create innovative solutions that make a difference for our clients worldwide
We cultivate a culture where you can express your ambition through initiatives like Purpose Day, a paid day off dedicated for you to use to invest in your growth and development.

What You’ll Be Doing (position summary):
• As a hands-on Senior Data Engineer, you will build ETL, analytics, and data consumption capabilities aligned to a multi-year product roadmap. Working with Product, Architecture, Data, and business stakeholders, you will translate business goals into scalable Databricks solutions using PySpark and modern engineering practices.
• You will serve as a senior technical contributor, partnering with Data Engineers, testers, and Data Analysts to solve complex challenges in data modeling, transformation, and consumption. You will design, develop, test, and implement secure cloud data solutions using Databricks, PySpark, Delta Lake, ETL, data quality, and lineage.
• You will drive engineering excellence through production-quality PySpark, code reviews, testing, reusable frameworks, CI/CD, and Databricks performance tuning. You will troubleshoot complex pipelines, improve reliability and cost efficiency, mentor peers, remove technical bottlenecks, and support releases.
• You will estimate technical work, identify platform optimizations, define engineering metrics, and contribute to Agile delivery through refinement, story sizing, and technical planning. You will build POCs to validate Databricks patterns and production readiness.
• Success in this role requires clear communication and technical presentation skills, with the ability to explain trade-offs, facilitate design discussions, and influence decisions through architecture and governance forums.
• This role is one of the early hires for US Technology, Data & AI at CIBC India, helping establish cross-site alignment and a strong engineering culture supporting enterprise and TDAI priorities. Work arrangements, including on-site and remote work, will be discussed during the interview process.
• At CIBC India we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. Details on your work arrangement (including on-site and remote work) will be discussed at the time of your interview.

How You’ll Succeed (responsibilities):
• Technical Delivery: Translate business needs into reliable Databricks data products; design and build PySpark pipelines; estimate work; manage dependencies; define quality metrics; and use GitHub Copilot responsibly within software engineering practices.
• Data Engineering and Architecture: Design secure, scalable Databricks solutions using PySpark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and Azure. Improve performance through partitioning, file optimization, testing, CI/CD, observability, and technical-debt reduction.
• Risk and Compliance: Embed privacy, security, auditability, data quality, and least-privilege access in solutions; follow governance standards; and support Compliance and Audit evidence needs.
• Collaboration and Technical Mentoring: Partner across product, architecture, operations, and U.S.-based teams; communicate designs and trade-offs clearly; mentor engineers through pairing and reviews; and share reusable Databricks and PySpark patterns.

CROSS-FUNCTIONAL RELATIONSHIPS:
• Technology management teams to ensure shared accountability for Technology strategy and objectives
• Enterprise Technology colleagues to ensure strategic alignment across projects
• Internal business partners including executive heads of CIBC lines of business, leadership teams, partner teams, and centers of excellence
• External technology vendors and partners providing critical solutions and services
• As an employee of CIBC, the incumbent must comply with all applicable CIBC and Line of Business policies, standards, guidelines and controls.
• As a key contributor to the business unit, this role has authority to recommend changes to business processes to improve operational efficiency and effectiveness.
• Our CIBC risk culture expects employees to identify, escalate, and help mitigate risk as part of daily responsibilities. We are all accountable for managing risk.
• As an employee of CIBC, the incumbent must conduct themselves, and foster an environment for others, in a manner consistent with our strong risk culture. This includes:
• Following the CIBC Code of Conduct and all applicable policies, frameworks, guidelines, processes, and controls
• Acting in accordance with our Purpose and shared values to support the Bank’s strategic goals
• Understanding and following the qualitative and quantitative components of our Risk Appetite Statements
• Completing all required mandatory training and applying the learnings in daily work
• Escalating concerns through appropriate channels such as HR, management, Ethics Hotline, or Whistleblower
• Speaking up when witnessing behaviors that create poor or unfair outcomes for clients, team members, or stakeholders
• Escalating matters that may result in adverse market practices or reputational harm to CIBC.

Experience: 8+ years of experience
Must Have Skills:
• 8+ years of data engineering experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience, ideally in financial services or technology
• 5+ years building production data applications with deep expertise in data modeling, distributed processing, and cloud data platforms
• Advanced proficiency in PySpark and Databricks, including Spark execution, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, workflows, and performance tuning
• Deep experience designing batch and streaming ingestion, transformation pipelines, data quality controls, and curated data models on Azure
• Strong Python, SQL, ETL, Azure SQL, and REST API skills, with working knowledge of Scala
• Ability to diagnose Spark jobs using execution plans and metrics, and optimize joins, partitions, caching, file sizes, clusters, and cost
• Strong automated testing and DevOps practices across Git, CI/CD, environment management, secrets, security, and release controls
• Experience implementing observability, lineage, schema evolution, failure recovery, and service-level monitoring for critical pipelines
• Proven ability to build POCs, establish reusable engineering patterns, and scale solutions to secure production workloads
• Ability to document designs, explain technical trade-offs, and present clear recommendations to engineering and business partners
• Strong collaboration skills and experience mentoring engineers through pairing, code reviews, and knowledge sharing
• Ability to own technical delivery, identify risks early, troubleshoot complex issues, and work effectively through ambiguity

Headquarters: London
 
URL: https://www.limitlesstech.com/

Limitless, in partnership with Netflix, is looking for Japanese-speaking freelance customer service representatives to support Netflix customers in Japan.

This is a fully remote freelance opportunity for people who are confident speaking with customers, comfortable using online systems and able to work independently from home.

You will provide voice-based customer support to Netflix customers, helping with account queries, service questions, technical issues and general support. You will use Netflix systems, knowledge resources and agreed support processes to provide clear, accurate and friendly resolutions.

Key responsibilities include:

• 

Providing customer support in Japanese by voice

• 

Helping customers with account, service and technical queries

• 

Following Netflix support processes and quality standards

• 

Using online systems and knowledge tools to resolve customer issues

• 

Delivering a professional, friendly and efficient customer experience

• 

Completing required training, assessments and programme updates

• 

Working independently from home while staying connected with the wider support team

What we are looking for:

• 

Fluent or near-native Japanese language ability

• 

Strong spoken communication skills

• Comfortable supporting customers by phone

• 

Confident using online systems and digital tools

• 

Reliable internet connection and suitable home working environment

• 

Ability to work independently and follow defined processes

• 

Customer service experience is useful but not essential

Training:

Training starts on 9th October 2026 and runs for four weeks, Monday to Friday, from 13:00 to 17:00 Japan Standard Time.

Training is delivered virtually in Japanese and attendance across the fixed training schedule is required.

Working hours:

Once live, the current available service windows are:

• 

Monday to Friday

• 

09:00-13:00 JST

• 

17:00-21:00 JST

Available working patterns and shifts will be confirmed during training.

Earnings:

You will be paid $20 USD per hour during training and the initial live period.

You will then move to an On-Target Earnings model of up to $20 USD per hour, linked to agreed service and performance measures. Please note, if you achieve the contract KPIs (speed of handling and quality), you WILL get $20 - we want and need to pay you $20 as that means we are hitting our targets!

Freelance arrangement:

This is an independent freelance opportunity, not an employed position. You will register on the Limitless platform and complete the required online verification, assessments and programme qualification stages before joining training. Payment is made monthly, directly to your PayPal. We do not withhold any earnings for any regulatory requirement. As an independant contractor, all regulatory requirements in your region are your responsibility. We accept freelancers from most countries and regions, however, if your country or region is not 'gig-friendly' it will not appear as an option, meaning you can not onboarding. The onboarding process should take no more than 1 hour total effort before being invited to training.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/limitless-technology-japanese-speaking-customer-service-agent-for-netflix-japan

2c0ede1a1e860648.description:
Headquarters: Remote
 
URL: https://www.toptal.com/

Job Summary

Our Client Advisors turn inbound interest from small- and medium-sized businesses into Toptal clients. You will be the first conversation a prospective client has with Toptal. You will respond to immediate-assistance requests within five minutes, quickly understand the business problem behind the request, connect necessary Toptal specialists, and help guide the client forward through the sales process.

You will need to do a great deal in a short conversation: establish trust, diagnose the need, recognize relevant opportunities, explain Toptal’s value proposition, address concerns, and convert the business to sale. This is a high energy, consultative sales role at inbound velocity where excellence will mean running a high volume of first conversations, asking better questions than the client expected, and constantly building momentum along the right Toptal offering path.

You will need to bring clarity and articulate value across Toptal’s full portfolio: specialized talent, global hiring and payroll through HireGlobal, and our AI-driven, platform-powered, outcome-focused services offerings.

Your ownership continues after the first call. You will represent the client through technical stages, keep them engaged between conversations, and resolve issues that slow a decision. You will manage those active opportunities alongside new incoming inquiries, knowing when to bring in specialists for deeper expertise.

Our ideal candidate is ambitious, competitive, driven by client service, and pairs that drive with genuine curiosity about how businesses work. If you want to build real consultative selling skills in a fast-paced environment and be compensated for it, this is the team you want to be part of.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

• Discovery and Diagnosis: You will run high energy, open-ended discovery on every inbound conversation. You will quickly establish rapport, understand what prompted the client to reach out, and uncover the business objective behind the stated request. You will use this to build the necessary sales momentum to keep clients engaged, earning the right to recommend before you recommend.

• Qualify, Manage, and Win the Opportunity: You will quickly identify what is driving the need, whether there is a real opportunity, identify the metrics that matter most to the client, and who is involved in the decision. You will explain why the relevant Toptal offering fits, address the client’s concerns, and ask for commitment. You will manage deal cycles from discovery through close and maintain accurate pipeline and forecast data in our CRM.

• Own progress after the call: You will give any necessary specialists a clear account of the client’s needs and prepare them for subsequent conversations, stay close as technical questions are resolved, and keep the client engaged through the next decision. Maintain clear next steps, timing, and blockers for each active opportunity while responding to new inbound requests.

• Portfolio Selling: Clients rarely arrive with their full set of needs articulated. You will be responsible for understanding the client’s broader growth plans, including global hiring, EOR and payroll needs, marketing and sales growth, financial, and technology challenges, and for positioning Toptal as a strategic partner rather than a single-transaction vendor.

• Client Experience: Clients are at the heart of everything we do. You will execute a client-centric approach across every interaction during pre-defined working hours, running rapid research on clients before outreach, asking focused questions to fill the gaps, and staying current on industry trends and the competitive landscape so that you bring a point of view to the conversation.

• Collaboration: You will work with your team and with cross-functional partners, including matching, delivery, HireGlobal, and Toptal’s service offerings experts, to respond promptly to high-volume inbound inquiries and to bring the right expertise into a deal at the right moment. Communicating clearly over Zoom and Slack is critical.

• Growth and Development: Our SMB team improves individually and as a team. You will review your own calls, seek and act on feedback, and contribute what you learn back to the team.

In the first week, expect to:

• Onboard and integrate into Toptal.

• Learn Toptal’s model, our team members, and our story.

• Begin our 1-1 sales training covering our value proposition, discovery framework, sales process, and delivery method.

• Become acquainted with the cross-functional teams you will work with to close new business.

• Listen to recorded client calls and identify what the advisor did well and what they missed.

In the first month, expect to:

• Complete our personalized sales training program, including mock calls and role-play scenarios.

• Run an inbound conversation independently: identify the client’s need, explain the relevant offering and value proposition, handle common concerns, and ask for commitment.

• Prepare clear briefs to bring necessary specialist teams into opportunities.

• Begin closing new business, while exercising discretion and independent judgment.

In the first three months, expect to:

• Be fully ramped and integrated into the team.

• Complete additional vertical-specific training.

• Manage incoming leads alongside active opportunities, keep clients engaged through technical stages, and deliver against conversion and conversation-quality targets.

• Maintain a healthy, accurately forecast pipeline moving through your funnel.

In the first six months, expect to:

• Have a solid history of claiming and closing new business by consistently meeting or exceeding both sales and quality expectations and targets.

• Identify where opportunities are losing momentum and improve your follow-through using evidence from your own work.

• Suggest process improvement areas to increase team efficiency and effectiveness, which may include providing consultation or advice to management on policies and procedures.

In the first year, expect to:

• Mentor new team members, helping them learn our model and pass along standard methodologies.

• Demonstrate sustained sales and quality performance across initial conversion and continued partnership opportunities on inbound existing clients.

• Be a reference point for the team on discovery quality and on positioning the full Toptal portfolio.

• Become a productive, collaborative, and consistent contributor to the team.

Required Qualifications

• 2–3 years of B2B sales experience (Account Executive, Inside Sales, Sales Development, Account Representative, or a related role).

• Demonstrated experience converting inbound opportunities into paying customers at scale, owning the sale from first call to close.

• Experience coordinating parallel sales opportunities, and maintaining sales momentum while other teams complete necessary work.

• Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.

• Full availability during your working hours to take client calls.

• Ability to work and thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company, managing a high volume of clients alongside competing deadlines.

• Exceptional time management is key to success in this role.

Preferred Qualifications

• Software, tech, or professional-services sales experience.

• Exposure to a named sales methodology — MEDDPICC, Challenger, SPIN, Sandler, or similar.

• Experience selling more than one product or service line into the same account.

• Familiarity with global hiring, EOR, or payroll concepts.
